description: Each case is a failure that the core produces. Each language has a producer of the same name that makes the REAL failure with its real code (a constructor, a validator, a service with a failing port) and the test checks that the code of the error found by the language is expected_code, the same in Go and Python (REQ-CNF-004). value_in_input says that the producer receives a secret-looking value as part of the invalid input: the message of the error must never contain it. The set of names is the set of producers of each language, and every code of the catalog must appear at least once.

cases.name: event_id_invalid
cases.description: A text that is not a UUIDv7 as an event id.

cases.name: severity_invalid
cases.description: A severity that is not one of the six values.

cases.name: actor_kind_invalid
cases.description: An actor kind that is not one of the values.

cases.name: identifier_blank
cases.description: An identifier of white space only.

cases.name: identifier_control_characters
cases.description: An identifier with a control character.

cases.name: hex_digits_invalid
cases.description: Hexadecimal digits that are not lowercase hexadecimal.

cases.name: time_zone_invalid
cases.description: A time zone that is not an IANA-shaped name.

cases.name: utc_instant_not_utc
cases.description: An instant with an offset that is not zero.

cases.name: utc_instant_text_invalid

cases.name: attribute_key_invalid

cases.name: attribute_value_invalid

cases.name: resource_identity_invalid

cases.name: number_out_of_range

cases.name: event_schema_invalid
